public.view_current_portfolio_value.name: view_current_portfolio_value
public.view_current_portfolio_value.definition:
SELECT
    wpv.account_key,
    wpv.cash_flows,
    wpv.stock_position_value,
    wpv.option_collateral_value,
    wpv.cumulative_transfers,
    wpv.total_portfolio_value,
    wpv.available_cash
  FROM "view_weekly_portfolio_value" wpv
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT account_key, MAX(week_start) as max_week_start
    FROM "view_weekly_portfolio_value"
    GROUP BY account_key
  ) latest_weeks ON wpv.account_key = latest_weeks.account_key
    AND wpv.week_start = latest_weeks.max_week_start

public.view_current_position.name: view_current_position
public.view_current_position.definition:
SELECT
    vwp.account_key,
    vwp.symbol,
    vwp.security_type,
    vwp.underlying_symbol,
    vwp.quantity,
    vwp.avg_cost_per_unit,
    vwp.first_transaction_date,
    vwp.last_transaction_date,
    vwp.position_value,
    vwp.position_status,
    vwp.unrealized_pnl,
    vwp.option_type,
    vwp.expiry_date,
    vwp.strike_price
  FROM "view_weekly_position" vwp
  INNER JOIN (
    SELECT account_key, MAX(week_start) as max_week_start
    FROM "view_weekly_position"
    GROUP BY account_key
  ) latest_weeks ON vwp.account_key = latest_weeks.account_key
    AND vwp.week_start = latest_weeks.max_week_start

public.view_daily_activity.name: view_daily_activity
public.view_daily_activity.definition:
WITH expiry_range AS (
    -- Find the furthest expiry date to determine our window
    SELECT
        a.account_key,
        COALESCE(MAX(s.expiry_date), CURRENT_DATE) as max_expiry_date
    FROM "dim_account" a
    LEFT JOIN "view_current_position" vp ON a.account_key = vp.account_key
    LEFT JOIN "dim_security" s ON s.symbol = vp.symbol AND s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL AND s.expiry_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND ABS(CAST(vp.quantity AS DECIMAL)) > 0
    WHERE a.is_active = true
    GROUP BY a.account_key
  ),
  all_weekdays AS (
    SELECT d.full_date, er.account_key
    FROM "dim_date" d, expiry_range er
    WHERE d.full_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months'
      AND d.full_date <= er.max_expiry_date
      AND EXTRACT(dow FROM d.full_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
  ),
  daily_data AS (
    SELECT
        d.full_date,
        d.week_starting_date,
        a.account_key,
        SUM(CASE WHEN tt.action_category = 'TRANSFER' THEN ft.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as daily_transfers,
        -- Use new stock profit logic: include non-stock gains and realized stock profits
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN tt.action_category NOT IN ('TRANSFER') AND ds.security_type != 'STOCK'
            THEN ft.net_amount
            ELSE 0
        END) +
        COALESCE(SUM(vsp.realized_profit), 0) as daily_gains,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN tt.action_category = 'TRADE' THEN ft.transaction_key END) as trade_count
    FROM "fact_transaction" ft
    JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN "dim_account" a ON ft.account_key = a.account_key
    JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
    JOIN "dim_security" ds ON ft.security_key = ds.security_key
    LEFT JOIN "view_stock_profit" vsp ON ft.account_key = vsp.account_key
      AND ft.transaction_key = vsp.transaction_key
    WHERE d.full_date <= CURRENT_DATE
      AND d.full_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months'
      AND EXTRACT(dow FROM d.full_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    GROUP BY a.account_key, d.full_date, d.week_starting_date
  ),
  -- Get weekly portfolio values using corrected stock position handling
  weekly_portfolio_data AS (
    SELECT
        account_key,
        week_start,
        total_portfolio_value,
        cumulative_transfers,
        LAG(total_portfolio_value) OVER (PARTITION BY account_key ORDER BY week_start) as previous_week_portfolio_value
    FROM "view_weekly_portfolio_value"
    WHERE week_start >= (CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months')::date
  ),
  daily_returns AS (
    SELECT
        dd.account_key,
        dd.full_date,
        dd.trade_count,
        dd.daily_gains as daily_premium,
        -- Use weekly portfolio values for percentage calculation
        CASE
            WHEN wpd.previous_week_portfolio_value IS NOT NULL AND wpd.previous_week_portfolio_value != 0
            THEN ROUND((dd.daily_gains / ABS(wpd.previous_week_portfolio_value)) * 100, 2)
            -- For first week, use cumulative transfers as baseline if available
            WHEN wpd.previous_week_portfolio_value IS NULL AND wpd.cumulative_transfers IS NOT NULL AND wpd.cumulative_transfers > 0
            THEN ROUND((dd.daily_gains / ABS(wpd.cumulative_transfers)) * 100, 2)
            ELSE 0
        END as daily_return_percent
    FROM daily_data dd
    LEFT JOIN weekly_portfolio_data wpd ON dd.account_key = wpd.account_key
      AND dd.week_starting_date = wpd.week_start
  ),
  daily_expiries AS (
    SELECT
        s.expiry_date as full_date,
        vp.account_key,
        COUNT(*) as expiring_contracts,
        STRING_AGG(DISTINCT s.underlying_symbol, ', ') as expiring_symbols
    FROM "view_current_position" vp
    JOIN "dim_security" s ON s.symbol = vp.symbol
    WHERE s.expiry_date IS NOT NULL
      AND s.expiry_date >= CURRENT_DATE
      AND ABS(CAST(vp.quantity AS DECIMAL)) > 0
      AND EXTRACT(dow FROM s.expiry_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 5
    GROUP BY s.expiry_date, vp.account_key
  )
  SELECT
      wd.account_key,
      wd.full_date as date,
      COALESCE(dr.trade_count, 0) as trade_count,
      COALESCE(dr.daily_premium, 0) as daily_premium,
      COALESCE(dr.daily_return_percent, 0) as daily_return_percent,
      COALESCE(de.expiring_contracts, 0) as expiring_contracts,
      de.expiring_symbols,
      (wd.full_date = CURRENT_DATE) as is_current_date
  FROM all_weekdays wd
  LEFT JOIN daily_returns dr ON wd.full_date = dr.full_date AND wd.account_key = dr.account_key
  LEFT JOIN daily_expiries de ON wd.full_date = de.full_date AND wd.account_key = de.account_key
  ORDER BY wd.account_key, date DESC

public.view_portfolio_distribution.name: view_portfolio_distribution
public.view_portfolio_distribution.definition:
SELECT
    account_key,
    underlying_symbol as symbol,
    SUM(position_value) as position_value,
    COUNT(*)::integer as instrument_count,
    (ABS(SUM(position_value)) / SUM(ABS(SUM(position_value))) OVER (PARTITION BY account_key)) * 100 as portfolio_percentage

  FROM "view_current_position"
  WHERE position_status = 'OPEN'
  GROUP BY account_key, underlying_symbol
  ORDER BY ABS(SUM(position_value)) DESC

public.view_portfolio_summary.name: view_portfolio_summary
public.view_portfolio_summary.definition:
WITH realised_monthly_pnl AS (
    -- Realised P/L for current month using viewStockProfit for stocks
    SELECT
      a.account_key,
      -- Non-stock trades (options, dividends, etc.) as direct cash flow
      SUM(CASE
        WHEN ds.security_type != 'STOCK' THEN ft.net_amount
        ELSE 0
      END) +
      -- Stock realized profits from viewStockProfit (only actual realized gains/losses)
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN ds.security_type = 'STOCK' THEN vsp.realized_profit
        ELSE 0
      END), 0) as monthly_realised_pnl
    FROM "fact_transaction" ft
    JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN "dim_account" a ON ft.account_key = a.account_key
    JOIN "dim_security" ds ON ft.security_key = ds.security_key
    JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
    LEFT JOIN "view_stock_profit" vsp ON ft.account_key = vsp.account_key
      AND ft.transaction_key = vsp.transaction_key
    WHERE
      tt.action_category IN ('TRADE', 'INCOME')
      AND d.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
      AND d.month_number = EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY a.account_key
  ),

  realised_yearly_pnl AS (
    -- Realised P/L for current year using viewStockProfit for stocks
    SELECT
      a.account_key,
      -- Non-stock trades (options, dividends, etc.) as direct cash flow
      SUM(CASE
        WHEN ds.security_type != 'STOCK' THEN ft.net_amount
        ELSE 0
      END) +
      -- Stock realized profits from viewStockProfit (only actual realized gains/losses)
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN ds.security_type = 'STOCK' THEN vsp.realized_profit
        ELSE 0
      END), 0) as yearly_realised_pnl
    FROM "fact_transaction" ft
    JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN "dim_account" a ON ft.account_key = a.account_key
    JOIN "dim_security" ds ON ft.security_key = ds.security_key
    JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
    LEFT JOIN "view_stock_profit" vsp ON ft.account_key = vsp.account_key
      AND ft.transaction_key = vsp.transaction_key
    WHERE
      tt.action_category IN ('TRADE', 'INCOME')
      AND d.year = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)
    GROUP BY a.account_key
  ),

  total_transfers_calc AS (
    -- Calculate total transfers (money deposited/withdrawn)
    SELECT
      a.account_key,
      SUM(ft.net_amount) as total_transfers
    FROM "fact_transaction" ft
    JOIN "dim_account" a ON ft.account_key = a.account_key
    JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
    WHERE
      tt.action_category = 'TRANSFER'
    GROUP BY a.account_key
  ),

  portfolio_value_start_of_month AS (
    -- Calculate portfolio value at start of month using viewWeeklyPortfolioValue
    SELECT
      wpv.account_key,
      wpv.total_portfolio_value as portfolio_value_start_month
    FROM "view_weekly_portfolio_value" wpv
    WHERE wpv.week_start = (
      SELECT MAX(week_start)
      FROM "view_weekly_portfolio_value" wpv2
      WHERE wpv2.account_key = wpv.account_key
      AND wpv2.week_start < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE)
    )
  ),

  portfolio_value_start_of_year AS (
    -- Calculate portfolio value at start of year using viewWeeklyPortfolioValue
    SELECT
      wpv.account_key,
      wpv.total_portfolio_value as portfolio_value_start_year
    FROM "view_weekly_portfolio_value" wpv
    WHERE wpv.week_start = (
      SELECT MAX(week_start)
      FROM "view_weekly_portfolio_value" wpv2
      WHERE wpv2.account_key = wpv.account_key
      AND wpv2.week_start < DATE_TRUNC('year', CURRENT_DATE)
    )
  )

  -- Final summary query using viewWeeklyPortfolioValue
  SELECT
    a.account_key,
    COALESCE(pv.total_portfolio_value, 0) as portfolio_value,
    COALESCE(pv.cash_flows, 0) as cash_balance,
    COALESCE(pv.available_cash, 0) as available_cash,
    COALESCE(pv.stock_position_value, 0) as stock_position_value,
    COALESCE(pv.option_collateral_value, 0) as option_collateral_value,
    COALESCE(mp.monthly_realised_pnl, 0) as monthly_pnl,
    COALESCE(yp.yearly_realised_pnl, 0) as yearly_pnl,

    -- Calculate percentage changes based on realized P&L vs portfolio value
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(pvsm.portfolio_value_start_month, 0) > 0
      THEN (COALESCE(mp.monthly_realised_pnl, 0) / pvsm.portfolio_value_start_month * 100)
      WHEN COALESCE(pv.cumulative_transfers, 0) > 0
      THEN ((COALESCE(pv.total_portfolio_value, 0) - COALESCE(pv.cumulative_transfers, 0)) / pv.cumulative_transfers * 100)
      ELSE 0
    END as monthly_pnl_percent,

    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(pvsy.portfolio_value_start_year, 0) > 0
      THEN (COALESCE(yp.yearly_realised_pnl, 0) / pvsy.portfolio_value_start_year * 100)
      WHEN COALESCE(pv.cumulative_transfers, 0) > 0
      THEN ((COALESCE(pv.total_portfolio_value, 0) - COALESCE(pv.cumulative_transfers, 0)) / pv.cumulative_transfers * 100)
      ELSE 0
    END as yearly_pnl_percent,

    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(pv.cumulative_transfers, 0) > 0
      THEN ((COALESCE(pv.total_portfolio_value, 0) - COALESCE(pv.cumulative_transfers, 0)) / pv.cumulative_transfers * 100)
      ELSE 0
    END as overall_percent_increase

  FROM "dim_account" a
  LEFT JOIN "view_current_portfolio_value" pv ON a.account_key = pv.account_key
  LEFT JOIN realised_monthly_pnl mp ON a.account_key = mp.account_key
  LEFT JOIN realised_yearly_pnl yp ON a.account_key = yp.account_key
  LEFT JOIN total_transfers_calc tt ON a.account_key = tt.account_key
  LEFT JOIN portfolio_value_start_of_month pvsm ON a.account_key = pvsm.account_key
  LEFT JOIN portfolio_value_start_of_year pvsy ON a.account_key = pvsy.account_key
  WHERE a.is_active = true

public.view_profit_distribution.name: view_profit_distribution
public.view_profit_distribution.definition:
SELECT
    a.account_key,
    s.underlying_symbol,
    SUM(CASE
        -- For options: include all net amounts (premiums received/paid)
        WHEN s.security_type != 'STOCK' THEN ft.net_amount
        -- For stocks: include realized profits from sales
        WHEN s.security_type = 'STOCK' THEN COALESCE(vsp.realized_profit, 0)
        ELSE 0
    END) as total_profit,
    COUNT(CASE
        WHEN s.security_type != 'STOCK' THEN 1
        WHEN s.security_type = 'STOCK' AND vsp.realized_profit IS NOT NULL AND vsp.realized_profit != 0 THEN 1
        ELSE NULL
    END)::integer as trade_count
  FROM "fact_transaction" ft
  JOIN "dim_security" s ON ft.security_key = s.security_key
  JOIN "dim_account" a ON ft.account_key = a.account_key
  JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
  LEFT JOIN "view_stock_profit" vsp ON ft.account_key = vsp.account_key
    AND ft.transaction_key = vsp.transaction_key
  WHERE tt.action_category = 'TRADE'
  GROUP BY a.account_key, s.underlying_symbol
  HAVING SUM(CASE
      WHEN s.security_type != 'STOCK' THEN ft.net_amount
      WHEN s.security_type = 'STOCK' THEN COALESCE(vsp.realized_profit, 0)
      ELSE 0
  END) != 0
  ORDER BY SUM(CASE
      WHEN s.security_type != 'STOCK' THEN ft.net_amount
      WHEN s.security_type = 'STOCK' THEN COALESCE(vsp.realized_profit, 0)
      ELSE 0
  END) DESC

public.view_stock_profit.name: view_stock_profit
public.view_stock_profit.definition:
WITH stock_transactions AS (
    -- Get all stock transactions ordered by date
    SELECT
      ft.transaction_key,
      ft.account_key,
      ds.symbol,
      ds.underlying_symbol,
      d.full_date as transaction_date,
      tt.action_code as transaction_type,
      ft.quantity,
      ft.price_per_unit,
      ft.net_amount,
      ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        PARTITION BY ft.account_key, ds.symbol
        ORDER BY d.full_date, ft.transaction_key
      ) as transaction_sequence
    FROM "fact_transaction" ft
    JOIN "dim_security" ds ON ft.security_key = ds.security_key
    JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
    WHERE ds.security_type = 'STOCK'
      AND tt.action_category = 'TRADE'
  ),

  running_calculations AS (
    SELECT
      st.*,
      -- Running quantity (cumulative shares owned)
      SUM(st.quantity) OVER (
        PARTITION BY st.account_key, st.symbol
        ORDER BY st.transaction_sequence
        ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
      ) as running_quantity,

      -- Running cost basis (remaining cost basis of held shares)
      -- This represents the total cost of shares still owned
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(st.quantity) OVER (
          PARTITION BY st.account_key, st.symbol
          ORDER BY st.transaction_sequence
          ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) > 0 THEN
          SUM(st.quantity) OVER (
            PARTITION BY st.account_key, st.symbol
            ORDER BY st.transaction_sequence
            ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
          ) * (
            SUM(CASE WHEN st.quantity > 0 THEN ABS(st.net_amount) ELSE 0 END) OVER (
              PARTITION BY st.account_key, st.symbol
              ORDER BY st.transaction_sequence
              ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            ) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN st.quantity > 0 THEN st.quantity ELSE 0 END) OVER (
              PARTITION BY st.account_key, st.symbol
              ORDER BY st.transaction_sequence
              ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
            ), 0)
          )
        ELSE 0
      END as running_cost_basis,

      -- Average cost per share up to this point (for shares still owned)
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN st.quantity > 0 THEN st.quantity ELSE 0 END) OVER (
          PARTITION BY st.account_key, st.symbol
          ORDER BY st.transaction_sequence
          ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) > 0
        THEN SUM(CASE WHEN st.quantity > 0 THEN ABS(st.net_amount) ELSE 0 END) OVER (
          PARTITION BY st.account_key, st.symbol
          ORDER BY st.transaction_sequence
          ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        ) / SUM(CASE WHEN st.quantity > 0 THEN st.quantity ELSE 0 END) OVER (
          PARTITION BY st.account_key, st.symbol
          ORDER BY st.transaction_sequence
          ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
        )
        ELSE 0
      END as avg_cost_per_share
    FROM stock_transactions st
  ),

  profit_calculations AS (
    SELECT
      rc.*,
      -- Calculate realized profit for sell transactions only
      CASE
        WHEN rc.quantity < 0 THEN
          -- For sells: (sale_price - avg_cost) * shares_sold
          (ABS(rc.net_amount) / ABS(rc.quantity)) * ABS(rc.quantity) -
          (rc.avg_cost_per_share * ABS(rc.quantity))
        ELSE 0
      END as realized_profit
    FROM running_calculations rc
  )

  SELECT
    pc.account_key,
    pc.symbol,
    pc.underlying_symbol,
    pc.transaction_date,
    pc.transaction_key,
    pc.transaction_type,
    pc.quantity,
    pc.price_per_unit,
    pc.net_amount,
    pc.running_quantity,
    pc.running_cost_basis,
    pc.avg_cost_per_share,
    pc.realized_profit,
    -- Cumulative realized profit over time
    SUM(pc.realized_profit) OVER (
      PARTITION BY pc.account_key, pc.symbol
      ORDER BY pc.transaction_sequence
      ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING
    ) as cumulative_realized_profit
  FROM profit_calculations pc
  ORDER BY pc.account_key, pc.symbol, pc.transaction_sequence

public.view_weekly_portfolio_value.name: view_weekly_portfolio_value
public.view_weekly_portfolio_value.definition:
WITH weekly_date_series AS (
    -- Generate all weeks from earliest transaction to current date
    SELECT DISTINCT
      week_start,
      account_key
    FROM "view_weekly_position"
  ),

  weekly_cash_flows AS (
    -- Calculate cumulative cash flows up to each week
    SELECT
      wds.account_key,
      wds.week_start,
      COALESCE(SUM(ft.net_amount), 0) as cash_flows_to_date
    FROM weekly_date_series wds
    LEFT JOIN "fact_transaction" ft ON ft.account_key = wds.account_key
    LEFT JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    WHERE d.week_starting_date <= wds.week_start OR ft.transaction_key IS NULL
    GROUP BY wds.account_key, wds.week_start
  ),

  weekly_transfers AS (
    -- Calculate cumulative transfers up to each week
    SELECT
      wds.account_key,
      wds.week_start,
      COALESCE(SUM(
        CASE WHEN tt.action_category = 'TRANSFER'
        THEN ft.net_amount
        ELSE 0 END
      ), 0) as cumulative_transfers
    FROM weekly_date_series wds
    LEFT JOIN "fact_transaction" ft ON ft.account_key = wds.account_key
    LEFT JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    LEFT JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
    WHERE d.week_starting_date <= wds.week_start OR ft.transaction_key IS NULL
    GROUP BY wds.account_key, wds.week_start
  )

  SELECT
    wcf.account_key,
    wcf.week_start,
    wcf.cash_flows_to_date as cash_flows,

    -- Stock position values from weekly positions (use premium cost basis)
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(vwp.position_value)
       FROM "view_weekly_position" vwp
       WHERE vwp.account_key = wcf.account_key
       AND vwp.week_start = wcf.week_start
       AND vwp.security_type = 'STOCK'
       AND vwp.position_status = 'OPEN'), 0
    ) as stock_position_value,

    -- Option collateral values using position_value (accounts for CALL=0, PUT=collateral)
    COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(vwp.position_value)
       FROM "view_weekly_position" vwp
       WHERE vwp.account_key = wcf.account_key
       AND vwp.week_start = wcf.week_start
       AND vwp.security_type = 'OPTION'
       AND vwp.position_status = 'OPEN'), 0
    ) as option_collateral_value,

    -- Cumulative transfers
    wt.cumulative_transfers,

    -- Total portfolio value = cash flows + stock position values
    wcf.cash_flows_to_date + COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(vwp.position_value)
       FROM "view_weekly_position" vwp
       WHERE vwp.account_key = wcf.account_key
       AND vwp.week_start = wcf.week_start
       AND vwp.security_type = 'STOCK'
       AND vwp.position_status = 'OPEN'), 0
    ) as total_portfolio_value,

    -- Available cash = cash flows - option collateral (using position_value)
    wcf.cash_flows_to_date - COALESCE(
      (SELECT SUM(vwp.position_value)
       FROM "view_weekly_position" vwp
       WHERE vwp.account_key = wcf.account_key
       AND vwp.week_start = wcf.week_start
       AND vwp.security_type = 'OPTION'
       AND vwp.position_status = 'OPEN'), 0
    ) as available_cash

  FROM weekly_cash_flows wcf
  JOIN weekly_transfers wt ON wcf.account_key = wt.account_key
    AND wcf.week_start = wt.week_start
  ORDER BY wcf.account_key, wcf.week_start

public.view_weekly_position.name: view_weekly_position
public.view_weekly_position.definition:
WITH weekly_date_series AS (
    -- Get all unique weeks where transactions occurred
    SELECT DISTINCT
      d.week_starting_date as week_start,
      ft.account_key
    FROM "fact_transaction" ft
    JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN "dim_account" a ON ft.account_key = a.account_key
    WHERE a.is_active = true
  ),

  -- For non-stock securities, use the original calculation
  non_stock_positions AS (
    SELECT
      wds.account_key,
      wds.week_start,
      ds.symbol,
      ds.security_type,
      ds.underlying_symbol,
      SUM(ft.quantity) as cumulative_quantity,
      CASE
        WHEN SUM(ABS(ft.quantity)) > 0
        THEN SUM(ABS(ft.net_amount)) / SUM(ABS(ft.quantity))
        ELSE 0
      END as avg_cost_per_unit,
      MIN(d.full_date) as first_transaction_date,
      MAX(d.full_date) as last_transaction_date,
      ds.expiry_date,
      ds.option_type,
      ds.strike_price
    FROM weekly_date_series wds
    JOIN "fact_transaction" ft ON ft.account_key = wds.account_key
    JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN "dim_security" ds ON ft.security_key = ds.security_key
    JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
    WHERE d.week_starting_date <= wds.week_start
      AND tt.action_category IN ('TRADE', 'CORPORATE')
      AND ds.security_type != 'STOCK'  -- Only non-stock securities
    GROUP BY wds.account_key, wds.week_start, ds.symbol, ds.security_type, ds.underlying_symbol, ds.expiry_date, ds.option_type, ds.strike_price
    HAVING SUM(ft.quantity) != 0
  ),

  -- For stocks, use viewStockProfit data aggregated by week
  stock_positions AS (
    SELECT
      wds.account_key,
      wds.week_start,
      vsp.symbol,
      'STOCK'::varchar(20) as security_type,
      vsp.underlying_symbol,
      -- Get the final position at the end of each week
      (SELECT vsp2.running_quantity
       FROM "view_stock_profit" vsp2
       JOIN "dim_date" d2 ON vsp2.transaction_date = d2.full_date
       WHERE vsp2.account_key = wds.account_key
         AND vsp2.symbol = vsp.symbol
         AND d2.week_starting_date <= wds.week_start
       ORDER BY vsp2.transaction_date DESC, vsp2.transaction_key DESC
       LIMIT 1) as cumulative_quantity,
      -- Get the FIFO average cost at the end of each week
      (SELECT vsp2.avg_cost_per_share
       FROM "view_stock_profit" vsp2
       JOIN "dim_date" d2 ON vsp2.transaction_date = d2.full_date
       WHERE vsp2.account_key = wds.account_key
         AND vsp2.symbol = vsp.symbol
         AND d2.week_starting_date <= wds.week_start
       ORDER BY vsp2.transaction_date DESC, vsp2.transaction_key DESC
       LIMIT 1) as avg_cost_per_unit,
      MIN(vsp.transaction_date) as first_transaction_date,
      MAX(vsp.transaction_date) as last_transaction_date,
      NULL as expiry_date,
      NULL as option_type,
      NULL as strike_price
    FROM weekly_date_series wds
    JOIN "view_stock_profit" vsp ON vsp.account_key = wds.account_key
    JOIN "dim_date" d ON vsp.transaction_date = d.full_date
    WHERE d.week_starting_date <= wds.week_start
    GROUP BY wds.account_key, wds.week_start, vsp.symbol, vsp.underlying_symbol
    HAVING (SELECT vsp2.running_quantity
            FROM "view_stock_profit" vsp2
            JOIN "dim_date" d2 ON vsp2.transaction_date = d2.full_date
            WHERE vsp2.account_key = wds.account_key
              AND vsp2.symbol = vsp.symbol
              AND d2.week_starting_date <= wds.week_start
            ORDER BY vsp2.transaction_date DESC, vsp2.transaction_key DESC
            LIMIT 1) > 0  -- Only open positions
  )

  SELECT
    COALESCE(nsp.account_key, sp.account_key) as account_key,
    COALESCE(nsp.week_start, sp.week_start) as week_start,
    COALESCE(nsp.symbol, sp.symbol) as symbol,
    COALESCE(nsp.security_type, sp.security_type) as security_type,
    COALESCE(nsp.underlying_symbol, sp.underlying_symbol) as underlying_symbol,
    COALESCE(nsp.cumulative_quantity, sp.cumulative_quantity) as quantity,
    COALESCE(nsp.avg_cost_per_unit, sp.avg_cost_per_unit) as avg_cost_per_unit,
    COALESCE(nsp.first_transaction_date, sp.first_transaction_date) as first_transaction_date,
    COALESCE(nsp.last_transaction_date, sp.last_transaction_date) as last_transaction_date,

    -- Position value calculation
    CASE
      WHEN COALESCE(nsp.security_type, sp.security_type) = 'STOCK' THEN
        ABS(COALESCE(sp.cumulative_quantity, 0)) * COALESCE(sp.avg_cost_per_unit, 0)
      WHEN nsp.security_type = 'OPTION' AND nsp.option_type = 'PUT' AND nsp.cumulative_quantity < 0 THEN
        ABS(nsp.cumulative_quantity) * nsp.strike_price * 100
      WHEN nsp.security_type = 'OPTION' AND nsp.option_type = 'PUT' AND nsp.cumulative_quantity > 0 THEN 0
      WHEN nsp.security_type = 'OPTION' AND nsp.option_type = 'CALL' AND nsp.cumulative_quantity > 0 THEN
        ABS(nsp.cumulative_quantity) * nsp.strike_price * 100
      WHEN nsp.security_type = 'OPTION' AND nsp.option_type = 'CALL' AND nsp.cumulative_quantity < 0 THEN 0
      ELSE ABS(COALESCE(nsp.cumulative_quantity, 0)) * COALESCE(nsp.avg_cost_per_unit, 0)
    END as position_value,

    'OPEN' as position_status,
    0 as unrealized_pnl,
    nsp.expiry_date,
    nsp.option_type,
    nsp.strike_price

  FROM non_stock_positions nsp
  FULL OUTER JOIN stock_positions sp ON nsp.account_key = sp.account_key
    AND nsp.week_start = sp.week_start
    AND nsp.symbol = sp.symbol
  ORDER BY COALESCE(nsp.account_key, sp.account_key), COALESCE(nsp.week_start, sp.week_start), COALESCE(nsp.symbol, sp.symbol)

public.view_weekly_return.name: view_weekly_return
public.view_weekly_return.definition:
WITH weekly_transfers AS (
    -- Calculate weekly transfers and gains using viewStockProfit for accurate stock calculations
    SELECT
      a.account_key,
      d.week_starting_date as week_start,
      SUM(CASE WHEN tt.action_category = 'TRANSFER' THEN ft.net_amount ELSE 0 END) as weekly_transfers,
      -- Separate non-stock gains from stock realized profits
      SUM(CASE
        WHEN tt.action_category = 'TRADE' AND ds.security_type != 'STOCK' THEN ft.net_amount
        WHEN tt.action_category = 'INCOME' THEN ft.net_amount
        ELSE 0
      END) +
      COALESCE(SUM(CASE
        WHEN tt.action_category = 'TRADE' AND ds.security_type = 'STOCK' THEN vsp.realized_profit
        ELSE 0
      END), 0) as weekly_gains
    FROM "fact_transaction" ft
    JOIN "dim_date" d ON ft.date_key = d.date_key
    JOIN "dim_account" a ON ft.account_key = a.account_key
    LEFT JOIN "dim_security" ds ON ft.security_key = ds.security_key
    JOIN "dim_transaction_type" tt ON ft.transaction_type_key = tt.transaction_type_key
    LEFT JOIN "view_stock_profit" vsp ON ft.account_key = vsp.account_key
      AND ft.transaction_key = vsp.transaction_key
    WHERE d.full_date <= CURRENT_DATE
    GROUP BY a.account_key, d.week_starting_date
  ),

  portfolio_with_transfers AS (
    -- Combine portfolio values with transfer data
    SELECT
      wpv.account_key,
      wpv.week_start,
      wpv.total_portfolio_value as cumulative_portfolio_value,
      wpv.cumulative_transfers,
      COALESCE(wt.weekly_transfers, 0) as weekly_transfers,
      COALESCE(wt.weekly_gains, 0) as weekly_gains
    FROM "view_weekly_portfolio_value" wpv
    LEFT JOIN weekly_transfers wt ON wpv.account_key = wt.account_key
      AND wpv.week_start = wt.week_start
  ),

  returns_calculation AS (
    SELECT
      account_key,
      week_start,
      cumulative_portfolio_value,
      cumulative_transfers,
      weekly_transfers,
      weekly_gains as weekly_return_absolute,
      -- LAG calculation for previous week's portfolio value
      LAG(cumulative_portfolio_value, 1) OVER (
        PARTITION BY account_key
        ORDER BY week_start
      ) as prev_week_portfolio_value
    FROM portfolio_with_transfers
  )

  SELECT
    account_key,
    week_start,
    cumulative_portfolio_value,
    cumulative_transfers,
    weekly_return_absolute,
    -- Weekly return calculation: handle first week properly
    CASE
      WHEN prev_week_portfolio_value > 0 THEN
        -- Normal case: previous week portfolio value exists, adjusted for mid-week transfers
        ((cumulative_portfolio_value - weekly_transfers - prev_week_portfolio_value)
          / (prev_week_portfolio_value + (weekly_transfers / 2))) * 100
      WHEN prev_week_portfolio_value IS NULL AND cumulative_transfers > 0 THEN
        -- First week case: use weekly gains relative to transfers
        (weekly_return_absolute / cumulative_transfers) * 100
      ELSE NULL
    END as weekly_return_percent
  FROM returns_calculation
  WHERE week_start <= CURRENT_DATE
  ORDER BY account_key, week_start
